name: Mystery Parcel
text: Before bidding, swap two cards with your partner.
prototypeNote: Before bidding, use Move card to swap two cards with your partner.

signature.target: two cards each, each player choosing

archetypes: Swap Meet; splash Kingmaker, Heart Chorus
decision: Which two cards to give before anyone bids: a singleton to open a void, high cards to make your partner's bid, or cards of the suit your partner is building.
opponent: The swap is shown to the table, but not the cards; opponents bid knowing your team reshaped its hands.
aiNote: Give your two lowest cards outside your longest suit; the partner gives its two lowest.
rationale: Two cards each before bidding is the uncommon step up from Sealed Letter's one-way pass and Open Hand's one card after bidding: both hands bid on the reshaped cards, and it moves four cards for Swap Meet's pass payoffs and Round-Trip Record.
deviation: Redesigned from swapping a chosen card for a random card from a chosen opponent, which was complicated and cumbersome.
